label: Fires at D1 after reaching S1, mostly after a1; earlier rewards weaken it, including within a1 S1 u.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * prev_reward ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * belief_lo
explanation: Active only at D1. Its magnitude is set mainly by the last trial: high when S1 was reached, highest after a1 -> S1 (about +2.2 above a2 -> S1), and near zero after any S2 trial. Within S1 trials, each recent reward (last trial and the 2 before it) lowers it, so long rewarded a1 S1 streaks give low activation and unrewarded ones give high. Belief log-odds adds only a little once the last trial is known. Within the key situation (D1 after a1 S1 u, mean 2.59 +/- 0.67) the short form only captures the reward-count part: on dev, the a1 S1 u indicator alone gives 0.1097 of whole-data R^2 beyond timing, adding the recent-reward count gives 0.1108, and an 8-term within-situation free fit (reward / state / common two trials back, whether the last trial was a stay, reward / action three trials back, episode trial) reaches only 0.1158. In that fit a stay into a1 raises it and earlier rewards or earlier S1 visits lower it. Belief, |belief_lo| and belief_cover explain nothing within a1 S1 u. Most of the within-situation variance is not explained by observed trial-history cues.
